:::{#exr-prac-exp-mle-ci}
#### Approximate confidence interval for the exponential mean

In the setting of @exr-prac-exp-mle, use the [observed information](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-oinf) at the [MLE](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-mle) from @exr-prac-exp-mle-oinf-at-mle to give an [approximate 95% confidence interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/inference.html#def-approximate-ci) for $\pmean$.

:::
